name: AI Usage
description: Unified Codex, Grok, Claude, and Antigravity usage app with multi-account Home Screen widgets, remaining-quota display, and per-account layouts.

localizedDescriptions.zh: 整合 Codex / Grok / Claude / Antigravity 用量的应用。支持多账号、按账号设置主屏幕小组件布局，小组件固定显示剩余额度，以及应用内 Safari 授权后粘贴完成登录。
localizedDescriptions.en: Unified Codex, Grok, Claude, and Antigravity usage app with multi-account Home Screen widgets, remaining-quota display, and per-account layouts.
